model.near_field_calibration: none; signed smooth exploratory regularization, not a Doinikov solution
model.mobility_force_balance: Each current lubrication component receives only the common velocity shift mean(U_free-U_local), enforcing sum(zeta*U)=sum(F). Relative velocities remain unchanged; no particle or group is locked.
model.contact: Jacobi PBD in diagonal Stokes mobility metric, weight mu_i/(mu_i+mu_j); monodisperse F1 weights 1/2
model.contact_vs_hydrodynamics: Local symmetric relative-mobility metric, not a full coupled Stokes contact projection
model.near_field_candidate: Pairwise linear fundamental monopole feedback using local table secant compliance; cubic signed correlation blend; harmonics 2-8 unchanged
model.near_field_limits: Not a collective radial response, multipole theory or calibrated near-field solution; Primary remains the uncoupled table Primary
model.feedback_window: Cubic smoothstep: 1 at d<=Ri+Rj; 0 at d>=4(Ri+Rj)
model.zero_drive_compliance: Lowest valid table-pressure secant; exact zero total drive still has zero response
model.contact_candidate: Frozen local normal-mobility tensors; symmetric pair H=(Mi+Mj)/2; equal/opposite correction overlap*H*n/(2*n.H*n), with fixed Jacobi relaxation
model.acoustic_domain: required only with nonzero enabled PZT drive
model.contact_metric: inherited diagonal central PBD; not full RPY constrained dynamics

Y1.numerical_semantics: Frozen F2 discrete model; ordered pair/member sums only in stable mode; contact and mobility kernels unchanged
Y1.repeatability_scope: Same GPU, compiler, inputs, block layout and software; no cross-device bitwise promise

flow_provider.interpolation: original tetrahedral P1; float64 membership/values; padded float32 BVH
flow_provider.gradient: piecewise-constant exact derivative of nodal P1 velocity; discontinuous at cell faces
flow_provider.outside: explicit error bit 16384; no nearest-neighbour or zero-velocity continuation

Y1.free_path_definition: Integral of |u_flow + F_ac/(6*pi*mu*R)| before local mobility/contact
Y1.mobility_scope: Two inherited local Jacobi iterations plus component mean balance; pair lubrication from ambient differences is approximate, not a global Stokes solve

cluster_definitions.meaning: spatial connected components; no adhesion or fusion

gate_crossing.method: Linear intersection of the fixed-ID centroid between consecutive accepted physical steps; derived intersection, not a saved sample frame

Y1.gpu_time_scope: CUDA events around run including graph capture, synchronization and host-idle gaps; not exclusive active-kernel time
